messages:
Marta (Partnerships): Heads-up: HaloHealth officially agreed to list their Redwood-integrated telemedicine workflow as an ISV offering on Azure Marketplace. Co-sell + Dedicated reserved capacity deal. Case study + press blurb approved. :tada:

Raj (AE): Huge!! 🎉 Pilot launched last month — already hitting ~2.5k monthly sessions. Committed to a 12-month reserved capacity. ARR ~ $180k. I'll DM finance for contract cert.

Sam (Solutions): Scheduled integration enablement Mon 9am PT. Need network peering + SSO/SCIM details from Halo. I'll post the runbook and the config checklist in #eng-ml after the call.

Eli (Product): Nice work. Can we prioritize adding their workflow to the demo catalog so marketplace listing has a live demo link? Who's owning the case study writeup?

Marta (Partnerships): Assigning @Kevin (Growth) and @Linda (Marketing). Kevin will lead the case study draft; Linda will own marketplace listing copy and hero screenshot. @Sam can provide screenshots and perf numbers.

Kevin (Growth): On it — draft by Friday EOD. Will include a short exec quote from HaloHealth CTO and 2-3 impact metrics (latency, cost delta, throughput). Looping in Legal for quote approval.

LegalBot: Reminder: Please attach an approved customer quote release form before publishing. Template: /legal/templates/customer-quote.md

Linda (Marketing): I’ll coordinate hero assets and the listing blurb. Can we get a before/after stat? e.g., '50% lower token costs with KV caching' — Sam, can you confirm and provide a screenshot?

Sam (Solutions): Yes — pulling the perf export now. Saving to S3: s3://redwood-partner-assets/halohealth/reports/marketplace-ready.csv. Will also add a short runbook snippet for the listing.

Raj (AE): FYI HaloHealth requested a co-branded webinar next quarter for pipeline gen. Suggest we schedule that into the GTM plan once the listing is live.

Marta (Partnerships): :thumbsup: Thanks team — big win. I’ll schedule a 20m kickoff for tomorrow 10am PT. Agenda: owners, timeline, marketplace assets, legal sign-off. If anyone has blocking items, please call them out here.
